fix.title: Citehound Fix: we fix what holds your site back
fix.description: Citehound Fix applies the technical changes the scan asks for and shows the before and after. From $299, fixed quote. Includes Citehound Pro.
fix.h1: We fix what holds your site back.
fix.sub: Schema, robots.txt, llms.txt, sitemap, titles and descriptions: prepared, applied, rescanned.
fix.stepsTitle: From scan to before and after.

steps.title: Scan
steps.text: We scan your site and list the gaps.

steps.title: Fix plan
steps.text: We agree with you which gaps to close, and in what order.

steps.title: We apply it
steps.text: We prepare each change and apply it.

steps.title: Rescan
steps.text: We scan again and send you the before and after.

fix.itemsTitle: The technical layer the score measures.

items.title: Schema
items.text: Organization, WebSite and content markup, so machines can tell who you are.

items.title: robots.txt
items.text: Clear rules for the AI crawlers, set the way you decide.

items.title: llms.txt
items.text: A short file that says what the site is and where its main pages are. It is optional and low-cost, and nobody has shown that it changes what Google does.

items.title: Sitemap
items.text: Declared in robots.txt and listing the pages that matter.

items.title: Titles
items.text: One clear title for each page.

items.title: Descriptions
items.text: One meta description for each page, written for that page.

fix.proofNote: These are AI-readiness scores: crawler access and on-page signals. They do not measure whether any assistant names a brand.

faq.q: What do Fix and Beyond cost?
faq.a: Fix starts at $299: a fixed quote after your scan, and the price does not change once agreed. It includes 3 months of Pro. Beyond is $490 a month with a 3-month minimum and limited seats, and it includes Pro. These are early-access prices and payments open soon. See the pricing page for what each includes.

faq.q: What does Fix change on my site?
faq.a: The technical layer the score measures: schema markup, robots.txt, llms.txt, the sitemap, page titles and meta descriptions. We agree with you which gaps to close first.
No. Fix covers the technical layer. Writing and editing content is Citehound Beyond.

faq.q: Do I need to buy Pro separately?
faq.a: No. Fix and Beyond both include Citehound Pro.

fix.requestText: Leave your email and the site. We reply to each request with a fixed quote.

beyond.title: Citehound Beyond: be the page assistants pick
beyond.description: Citehound Beyond researches your customers’ questions, writes the content you approve and re-measures monthly. $490 a month. Includes Citehound Pro.
beyond.h1: Readable is not enough. Be the page assistants pick.
beyond.sub: We research the questions your customers ask, read your pages against them and write the content: new pages, FAQ and comparison blocks, rewrites. Human-edited. You approve it, we publish or hand it over, and we re-measure every month.
beyond.stepsTitle: From their questions to your pages.

steps.title: Market questions
steps.text: We research the questions your customers ask, in their words, starting from your site.

steps.title: Your pages read against them
steps.text: For each question: what your pages answer, what they don’t, what is missing.

steps.title: We write the content
steps.text: New pages, FAQ and comparison blocks, rewrites. Human-edited. You approve every piece.

steps.title: Publish, then re-measure
steps.text: We publish it or hand it over. Each month we run the same questions again and send the citation check, including when nothing changed.

questions: What is the best invoicing tool for a freelancer?
How do I send a recurring invoice?
Which invoicing tool connects to my bank?
Can I invoice in two currencies?
How do I chase a late payment?
Is there an invoicing tool with no monthly fee?

gaps.q: Best invoicing tool for a freelancer

draft.brief: Answer “How do I send a recurring invoice?” on /help/recurring. The answer sits under background.
draft.title: How to send a recurring invoice
draft.text: Open Invoices, choose New and switch on Repeat. Pick how often it repeats and the day it is sent. The next invoice goes out on its own until you stop it.

beyond.bandText: We automate the question research and the page reading. People edit the drafts, and we re-measure every month. You approve every piece, and nothing is published without you.

bandCols.title: You approve
bandCols.text: Every piece, before we publish it or hand it over.

faq.q: What do Fix and Beyond cost?
faq.a: Fix starts at $299: a fixed quote after your scan, and the price does not change once agreed. It includes 3 months of Pro. Beyond is $490 a month with a 3-month minimum and limited seats, and it includes Pro. These are early-access prices and payments open soon. See the pricing page for what each includes.

faq.q: Does anything go live without my approval?
faq.a: No. You approve every piece before we publish it or hand it over.

faq.q: How do you measure the result?
faq.a: We run the same questions each month and send the citation check: a dated sample, one run each; API results can differ from the consumer apps. We report what changed, including when nothing did.

faq.q: Do I need to buy Pro separately?
faq.a: No. Fix and Beyond both include Citehound Pro.
